learnings.learning: Seeing race percentiles can be valuable on its own
learnings.takeaway: Keep performance analysis useful before asking people to connect.

learnings.learning: Training partners need to be nearby
learnings.takeaway: Use home city rather than race to match people [done]. Consider asking where people currently train.

learnings.learning: Similar finish times can hide different strengths
Recent training and strava logs help people get value from a training partner.
learnings.takeaway: expose partner's recent workouts, routes, and availability.

learnings.learning: Reaching out requires both a contact route and willingness
learnings.takeaway: Try introductions through a club or a shared workout.

learnings.learning: People share the app outside its Share button
learnings.takeaway: Ask how people heard about the app; Share clicks miss referrals.

learnings.learning: Race photos can feel intriguing and intrusive
learnings.takeaway: Check whether photos help people or make them uncomfortable.
